t.BUTYL_METHOXYDIBENZOYLMETHANE.agn: In the EU it may be used as a UV filter at up to 5% (Annex VI, entry 8).
t.BUTYL_METHOXYDIBENZOYLMETHANE.eff.0: Apart from the 5% limit there is no substance-specific health warning in the EU. No substance-level scientific assessment has been read for this entry yet.
t.BUTYL_METHOXYDIBENZOYLMETHANE.reg.0: EU Cosmetics Regulation Annex VI, entry 8: Permitted UV filter, with an upper limit.
t.BUTYL_METHOXYDIBENZOYLMETHANE.summary: The most common UVA filter in sunscreens.
